# Frigade

> Frigade builds AI-native tools for product onboarding and in-app guidance. Two products: Frigade Assistant, an AI agent that learns your product by using it and guides users through real workflows; and Frigade Engage, a drop-in React component library for code-driven onboarding flows.

For a long-form, single-file version with detailed product, pricing, security, and FAQ content, see https://frigade.com/llms-full.txt.

Customers include Productboard, Merge, Arc, Sanity, Valley, Hotplate, and Orb. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliant.

## Products

Frigade ships two products. Use either independently or both together.

**Frigade Assistant** is an AI agent that navigates your product the way a user does, then guides users through multi-step tasks inside your app. No flows to configure, no decision trees, no docs to maintain. The agent stays current automatically as your product changes. Setup is the same as adding a user to your product.

**Frigade Engage** is a drop-in React component library for code-driven onboarding: checklists, tours, banners, announcements, surveys. The defaults (animation curves, empty states, the way a checklist collapses on the last step) are sweat-tested so teams can install on a Friday and ship something polished by Monday. Override every component, animation, or copy line when you want to.

Most companies pick one based on who's building. Assistant for product, support, and growth teams who want the AI to figure out the path. Engage for engineering teams who want full code-level control. Some use both.

## What Frigade Assistant does

- Guides users through multi-step tasks inside the product UI
- Takes actions on behalf of users (form fills, navigation, feature activation)
- Detects where users get stuck and proactively offers help
- Hands off to human support with full context when needed
- Provides insights on user behavior and friction points
- Supports theming and full white-label customization

## Use cases

- **Onboarding and activation**: guided flows tailored to each user, no manual configuration
- **Customer support**: step-by-step guidance inside the product, reducing ticket volume
- **Feature adoption**: surface underused features at the right moment
- **Product marketing**: in-app announcements and promotions without a code change
- **User research**: in-app surveys and forms in natural workflows
- **Revenue expansion**: in-app upsells and trial-to-paid conversion flows

## Pricing

- **Free**: live demo access, no setup required
- **Growth**: starting at $1,000/month. Includes 5 seats, 2 agents, 2,500 queries with volume discounts.
- **Enterprise**: custom pricing. Unlimited agents, SSO, EU data residency, self-hosting, custom DPA, dedicated support.

See https://frigade.com/pricing for the full plan comparison.

## Integrations

- **Analytics**: PostHog, Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel, Heap, Rudderstack, Google Analytics
- **CRM and help desk**: HubSpot, Salesforce, Intercom, Zendesk, Pylon, Freshdesk, Front, Help Scout
- **Communication**: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord
- **Developer docs**: Mintlify, ReadMe, GitBook, Notion
- **Custom**: REST API, JavaScript SDK, React SDK, Mobile SDK (Enterprise), webhooks

## Security and compliance

SOC 2 Type II certified. GDPR compliant. Enterprise plans include SAML 2.0 SSO, EU data residency, self-hosting, and custom data processing agreements. 99.9% uptime guarantee. Self-hosting is the primary option for security-sensitive customers; Frigade can run entirely on your infrastructure.

## Company

Frigade was founded by Eric Brownrout (CEO) and Christian Mathiesen (CTO). They met as interns at LinkedIn in 2015 and saw firsthand how a powerful internal onboarding platform changed user engagement. They started Frigade in San Francisco in 2022 to bring that capability to other companies. Backed by Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, General Catalyst, Defy.vc, and Magic Fund. Angel investors include Guillermo Rauch (Vercel), Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox), and Jean-Denis Greze (Plaid).

The team works in person from a Market Street office in San Francisco. Frigade is used inside Frigade: every onboarding flow, banner, and tour the team's own customers see runs through the same SDK they're integrating against, so customer-facing bugs get caught internally first.

## Feature pages

- [Suggestions](https://frigade.com/features/suggestions): proactive AI nudges and magic links that bring help to the user in the moment they need it
- [Tool calls](https://frigade.com/features/tool-calls): the assistant takes actions on the user's behalf instead of only describing the steps
- [Integrations](https://frigade.com/features/integrations): how Frigade fits into your existing analytics, CRM, support, and developer stack
- [Always accurate](https://frigade.com/features/always-accurate): how the agent stays current as your product ships, with no scheduled audits
- [AI-generated product tours](https://frigade.com/features/ai-generated-tours): walkthroughs the agent builds on demand for the actual user and the current UI
- [Insights](https://frigade.com/features/insights): auto-categorized themes from every conversation, so you see why users get stuck and act on it
- [Feedback and fine-tuning](https://frigade.com/features/feedback): coach the assistant in plain language and ratings, no engineering required
- [Developer experience](https://frigade.com/features/developer): the API, controls, and headless options for engineering teams
